_comment: Ids from owed-baseline.txt that the CURRENT golden no longer owes (moved to SKIP/FAIL, or
dropped from cells.json) — named here with an owner and a rationale so the loss is a decision,
not silence. replay.sh reads this file; an id it does not cover is RED. `cells` is a regex over
the cell id (same convention as accepted-differences.json's `cells` field).
Coverage GROWING (a new id owed that was not in the baseline) needs no entry here — it is
always allowed and just printed; only a SHRINK needs to be named.
Nothing has been dropped from the 1.5.5 golden since owed-baseline.txt was generated from
golden/1.5.5/ledger.tsv's PASS rows.
CLOSED (OR-OP-2, busbar-oracle v0.3.18): gemini-tool-use-token-term. The mock now answers a
`tool-use-tokens` control on gemini's chat leaf with `usageMetadata.toolUsePromptTokenCount`;
llm|gemini|gemini|request|ok_tool_use_tokens is recorded (golden/1.5.5), needs_fixture lifted,
and owed-baseline.txt carries it. Removed from `accepted` rather than left stale: the gap this
entry named no longer exists, and a gap entry with no matching gap is a claim about nothing.
CLOSED (EG-1, busbar-oracle v0.3.14 + v0.3.15, carried by this tree's v0.3.20 pin):
llm-stream-upstream-error-needs-recorder. The six `llm|<d>|<d>|request|stream_upstream_error`
cells were unrecordable for a RECORDER reason, not a mock one: record.sh's llm driver wrote the
mock control for `upstream_down` alone, and build-request.py streamed only for ok_stream /
ok_stream_array, so a cell ordering a mid-stream fault was posted BUFFERED and recorded the happy
path under the name of the failure. v0.3.14 routed every driver through cell_mock_control and
v0.3.15 made a request stream because the CELL says so; re-measured on the same published 1.5.5
binary under this pin, all six record the dialect's own mid-stream error frames and a usage delta
of {"requests":1} with no spend and no tokens. needs_fixture is lifted, the six are recorded in
golden/1.5.5, and owed-baseline.txt carries them. No entry is left behind: a gap entry with no
matching gap is a claim about nothing.
